articles.title: Israel's top court allows Arab parties to run in election

articles.title: Europe to release diesel reserves after Trump request
articles.description: The US leader asked European countries to release some of their diesel reserves to ease the rising prices. The issue has damaged Trump's popularity back home.

articles.description: Investors seeking the fastest but most costly route to Argentine citizenship can choose between a non-refundable gift of $350,000, or buying a government bond for $800,000, if they think that will pay off in the end.

articles.summary: 著名な気候変動リーダーたちが、2030年までに世界中で太陽光発電の普及を加速させ、安価でクリーンなエネルギーで世界を再構築するよう提唱している。

articles.title: North and South Korea trade accusations over landmines that injured three soldiers
articles.description: A mine blast that injured three South Korean soldiers has renewed scrutiny of North Korea's actions along the border and raised questions about its strategic goals.

articles.description: Since being bought by the UAE in 2008, Manchester City have become one of the world's most successful football clubs. A raft of serious financial charges threatens to undermine this and bring chaos to the Premier League.
articles.titleJa: マンチェスター・シティのプレミアリーグ告発：その意味とは？
articles.summary: UAEに買収されて以来、世界有数の成功を収めてきたマンチェスター・シティに深刻な財務違反の告発がなされ、クラブとそのプレミアリーグでの地位が脅かされている。

articles.title: Half of Europe witnessed record heat stress this summer — EU
articles.description: The EU's climate monitor said this summer was third-warmest for the continent on record. European rivers also registered their lowest average flows since records began in 1992.
articles.titleJa: 今夏、欧州の半分が記録的な熱ストレスを経験 — EU発表
articles.summary: EUの気候監視機関によると、今夏は欧州大陸にとって史上3番目に暑く、欧州の河川は1992年の記録開始以来、最低平均流量を記録した。

articles.title: Row erupts over Cairo mural depicting Tutankhamun and Nefertiti with dark skin
articles.description:
Artwork created in Tahrir Square for Chinese president’s state visit to Egypt is painted over amid allegations it revived Afrocentric claims about Pharaohs’ origins
On the eve of Chinese president Xi Jinping’s state visit to Cairo last month, the city authorities were busy removing a 66-metre-long mural from the esteemed guest’s line of sight.
Depicting the Pharaoh Tutankhamun and Queen Nefertiti, the painting was among 40 murals commissioned to beautify the city for Xi’s arrival and was painted by volunteer youth group Rasmet Basma, in Tahrir Square.

articles.titleJa: カイロの壁画、ツタンカーメンとネフェルティティを肌の黒い姿で描いたことで論争勃発
articles.summary: 中国国家主席のエジプト訪問を控え、ツタンカーメンとネフェルティティを黒い肌で描いたカイロの壁画が、ファラオの出自に関するアフリカ中心主義的主張を再燃させるとの疑惑から塗りつぶされ、論争を呼んでいる。

articles.title: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda abroad
articles.description:
Support such as for white Afrikaners and anti-communism reveals how US is redefining what qualifies as human rights
With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”.
On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests not to do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The state department declined to comment on questions from the Guardian specifically on whether it had obligated the funds and had “blown” holds from Congress due to concerns about the money’s use.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ政権、人権資金を海外での極右政策推進に転用

articles.title: South African leader urges men to speak up on gender-based violence after series of killings
articles.description:
President announces measures amid anger at authorities over recent murders of women
South Africa’s president has called on men to take more responsibility for violence against women as he announced measures to tackle the problem, amid anger at authorities over a recent wave of murders.
Cyril Ramaphosa acknowledged that not enough had been done to protect women. He said police would be reviewing unsolved murders, attempted murders and serious sexual offences against women and children, as well as producing a funded plan to reduce the forensic backlog for such cases, both within 60 days.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカ大統領、相次ぐ殺害事件を受け、ジェンダーに基づく暴力について男性に発言を促す
articles.summary: 南アフリカのラマポーザ大統領は、女性殺害事件が相次ぐ中、ジェンダーに基づく暴力に対し男性が責任を持つよう訴え。未解決事件の見直しや、法医学鑑定の遅延解消計画を発表した。

articles.title: Burundi agrees to receive ‘third-country’ migrant deportees from US
articles.description:
Burundi joins several other African nations in accepting people deported under Trump’s hardline policy
Burundi has agreed to join a clutch of ⁠other African nations in receiving migrants from other countries deported from the US under ⁠Donald Trump’s hardline ⁠immigration ​policy.
However, Burundi will only accept those not accused of crime or terrorism links, said ⁠Nancy Ninette Mutoni, a spokesperson for the country’s president, Évariste Ndayishimiye. Tuesday’s announcement gave no details of numbers, timing or financial ⁠details.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブルンジ、米国からの「第三国」移民送還者の受け入れに同意
articles.summary: ブルンジが、トランプ政権の強硬な移民政策に基づき、米国から第三国へ送還される移民の受け入れに同意した。ただし、犯罪やテロ関連の容疑がない者に限る。

articles.title: DRC politician beaten to death after radio appearance about Ebola outbreak
articles.description:
Marie-Celestin Karondwa was attacked on Sunday after promoting measures to prevent spread of disease, his party says

A senior member of the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s ruling party was beaten to death on Sunday after appearing on a radio programme to raise awareness about the Ebola outbreak, a party representative has said.
Marie-Celestin Karondwa, the acting president of the Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS) party’s federal executive committee in Butembo, a new hotspot for the outbreak, was attacked after taking part in a ​radio show during which he ‌promoted prevention measures for the disease, ‌the UDPS federation in the city said in a statement, Reuters reported.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国の政治家、エボラ出血熱対策に関するラジオ出演後、撲殺される
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国の与党幹部が、エボラ出血熱対策番組出演後に撲殺された。感染拡大防止策を推進したことが攻撃の原因とみられ、ブテンボでの悲劇に衝撃が走る。

articles.title: US Coast Guard says it intercepted ship carrying fuel to Cuba
articles.description:
US says ship thought to be using common ‘dark fleet’ tactics was boarded and taken to Mexico as embargo continues
The US Coast ⁠Guard has announced that it intercepted a large cargo ship carrying fuel bound for Cuba, as the ⁠Trump administration’s crippling ⁠oil embargo against ​the island nation continued.
The vessel named Grace was stopped on 5 September in the Caribbean Sea between Cuba ⁠and Mexico while using tactics to evade authorities, the Coast Guard said. The New York Times reported that the ship ⁠was 91 metres (300ft) long.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国沿岸警備隊、キューバへ燃料を運ぶ船を阻止したと発表
articles.summary: 米国沿岸警備隊が、キューバ行き燃料船をカリブ海で阻止しメキシコへ連行。トランプ政権によるキューバへの石油禁輸措置が続く中、「ダークフリート」戦術使用とされ拿捕された。

articles.title: ‘No one disrespects Our Lady’: fears for Brazil’s patron saint grip country ahead of election
articles.description:
Speculation that Flávio Bolsonaro will try to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of position could become deciding factor in run-up to Sunday
A row of Biblical proportions has erupted in the run-up to Brazil’s presidential election, with the country’s patron saint, Our Lady of Aparecida, emerging as an unlikely kingmaker in the deadlocked race.
Ahead of Sunday’s vote, the two frontrunners – the leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and his far-right challenger, Flávio Bolsonaro – are level in the polls.

articles.titleJa: 「聖母を侮辱する者はいない」：ブラジル、選挙を前に守護聖人への懸念が国を覆う
articles.summary: ブラジル大統領選を前に、守護聖人アパレシーダの聖母の地位剥奪の憶測が広がり、選挙の行方を左右する可能性に国民の懸念が高まっている。

articles.title: The Bolsonaros…they’re back! Brazil heads to the polls – podcast
articles.description:
Latin America correspondent Tom Phillips reports on this Sunday’s historic presidential elections in Brazil, as the son of jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro hopes to take power
You would have been forgiven for thinking that when Jair Bolsonaro was convicted in September 2025 of attempting a coup, his political career was finished and his legacy forever tainted.
But in the first round of Brazil’s presidential elections this Sunday, another Bolsonaro has genuine hopes of victory – not Jair, but his son Flávio, who ialso campaigning to have his father released released.

articles.titleJa: ボルソナーロ家が帰ってきた！ブラジルは投票へ – ポッドキャスト
articles.summary: 今週日曜日、ブラジルで歴史的な大統領選挙が行われる。収監中のジャイール・ボルソナーロ前大統領の息子が政権奪還を目指しており、その動向に注目が集まる。

articles.title: Brazil attorney general says meddling ‘cannot be tolerated’ after Trump funding plans revealed
articles.description:
Jorge Messias calls Guardian report ‘an important alert for Brazilian sovereignty’ as nation prepares to go to polls
Brazil’s attorney general has said foreign meddling in his country’s institutions and democracy “cannot be tolerated” after a Guardian report revealed how the Trump administration was pushing to direct funds to a campaign against the Brazilian supreme court.
Writing on X, Jorge Messias called the report “an important alert for Brazilian sovereignty”. “The information is especially serious in light of Brazil’s electoral process and the recent episodes of external pressure on our institutions,” Messias added.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブラジル司法長官、トランプ氏の資金提供計画発覚後、内政干渉は「容認できない」と表明
articles.summary: トランプ政権のブラジル最高裁への資金提供計画発覚後、ブラジル司法長官は内政干渉を容認しないと表明。この報道をブラジル主権への重要な警告と位置付けた。

articles.title: ‘It’s utter surrealism’: Venezuela’s Chavistas lament government’s embrace of Trump
articles.description:
Diehard Hugo Chávez supporters struggle to comprehend ideological U-turn being executed by Delcy Rodríguez’s interim administration
He was one of the most passionate propagandists for Hugo Chávez’s Bolivarian revolution: a feisty leftist TV personality who spent more than two decades singing the movement’s praises on his state-funded show, The Razorblade.
Mario Silva’s devotion was such that he often hosted his programme with Chávez’s portrait behind him and he had El Comandante’s curly signature tattooed on to his left wrist.

articles.titleJa: 「全くの超現実主義だ」：ベネズエラのチャベス主義者たち、政府のトランプ氏容認を嘆く
articles.summary: ベネズエラの熱心なチャベス主義者たちは、暫定政権がトランプ氏を受け入れるというイデオロギー的転換に苦悩。長年の忠誠にもかかわらず、この「超現実的」な変化を理解できないと嘆く。

articles.title: The solar system will fall apart far sooner than anyone thought, scientists say

articles.title: G7 agrees 100 million-barrel emergency oil release amid US pressure over diesel

articles.titleJa: プーチン大統領、ロシアのカリーニングラードが攻撃されれば「すべての兵器が議題に」と発言

articles.title: 5,000 drones turn China’s night sky into a giant light show

articles.title: Spanish Congress rejects housing laws despite Sánchez's warning: 'They'll be judged sooner than they think'
articles.description: Spanish Congress rejects two key housing measures aimed at quelling public uproar over housing affordability. The bills' rejection after last-minute talks leaves Pedro Sánchez's government without two key housing measures and exposes its struggle to win support in Congress.

articles.title: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat

articles.title: Rosenberg: Putin shows no sign of stopping the war as Russia doubles down on Ukraine
articles.description: A foreign policy speech by the Russian president will be keenly watched, but all signs point to the full-scale invasion continuing.

articles.title: 'I was lured into a trap': Evan Gershkovich on moment that led to 16 months in Russian jail

articles.title: Migrants using longer, more dangerous routes across Channel
articles.description: The government says it is bearing down on dangerous small boat crossings.

articles.title: The wealthy Cuban Americans ready and waiting for Havana to fall

articles.summary: フロリダのキューバ系亡命者たちが、キューバでの政権交代が間近であると期待を強めている状況を伝える。

articles.title: More than 5,000 people killed or injured in Haiti due to gang violence this year, UN says
articles.description: The United Nations said violent gangs continue to "adapt and expand" across the country, further threatening its stability.

articles.summary: 国連によると、ハイチでギャング暴力が拡大し、今年5,000人以上が死傷。国の安定がさらに脅かされている状況を報告。

articles.title: Venezuelan man shot by ICE in Texas is charged with assault

articles.description: The 13-month-old small canine is equipped with protective gear and a camera, and is being trained for search-and-rescue missions.

articles.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast

articles.titleJa: ハリケーン・ポロ、メキシコ太平洋岸に上陸
articles.summary: ハリケーン・ポロが、人気観光地であるバハ・カリフォルニア半島に上陸。地域への影響が懸念される状況を伝える。

articles.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow

articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ、選挙要求の高まりの中で数十人の政治犯を釈放

articles.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election
articles.description: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".
articles.titleJa: ブラジルのルーラ大統領、大統領選を前にオンラインギャンブルを禁止
articles.summary: ブラジルのルーラ大統領が、大統領選を前にオンラインギャンブルを「癌」と表現し禁止すると表明。激戦の選挙戦に影響か。

articles.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
articles.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
articles.titleJa: 新種の野生ネコ科動物が発見される — 既知の現存種は1匹のみ
articles.summary: 長らく近縁種と誤認されてきた斑点のある野生ネコ科動物が、ボリビアで新種として特定された。現存する既知の個体は1匹のみ。

articles.title: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US
articles.description: Haitian immigrants make up a large portion of the already overburdened home-care workforce.
articles.titleJa: 「彼は命の恩人だった」—米国でハイチ人介護者が解雇され、家族が途方に暮れる

articles.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
articles.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の対応が鍵に
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島に関して「変化の風」を約束。ドナルド・トランプ氏が英国統治への姿勢を変えるか注目される。

articles.title: In Brazil’s capital, residents grow their own heat-fighting solutions
articles.description: Life in the favelas surrounding Brazil’s capital brings the health risks of extreme heat — a symptom of the global inequities of green space access
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの首都で、住民たちが暑さ対策の解決策を自ら育てる
articles.summary: ブラジルの首都のファベーラでは、住民が猛暑による健康リスクに直面。緑地の不平等が問題となる中、住民は独自の暑さ対策を講じている。

articles.title: Equating protest with terrorism: A narrative against dissent
articles.description: In this month's edition, we dive deep into a narrative used by leaders in the United States and other countries to delegitimize protests.
articles.titleJa: 抗議活動をテロリズムと同一視すること：異議に対する物語
articles.summary: 米国をはじめとする国の指導者たちが、抗議活動を不当と見なすために用いる物語について深く掘り下げ、異議を抑圧する手法を検証する。

articles.title: The commodification of Indigenous cultures and traditions
articles.description: Too often, resources and meaning flow outward from the community that created them and enrich outsiders — often the same groups that have been oppressing them for centuries.
articles.titleJa: 先住民族の文化と伝統の商品化
articles.summary: 先住民族の文化や伝統が商品化され、その資源や意味がコミュニティから流出し、抑圧してきた外部の者に利益をもたらす現状を指摘する。

articles.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
articles.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
articles.titleJa: エクアドルが米国からの送還後、ホセ・セラーノ元大臣を拘束
articles.summary: 米国から送還されたエクアドルの元「スーパー大臣」ホセ・セラーノ氏が、重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面。司法制度の適正手続きも問われている。

articles.title: The A’uwẽ-Xavante people's denunciation of megaprojects in Brazil
articles.description: An Indigenous-led campaign denounces the impacts of a mega railway project and demands respect for territory, self-determination, and the right to live and dream.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルにおけるアウウェ＝シャバンテ族によるメガプロジェクトの非難
articles.summary: ブラジルの先住民族アウウェ＝シャバンテ族が、メガ鉄道プロジェクトの影響を非難。土地の尊重、自己決定、生活する権利を求める運動。

articles.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
articles.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
articles.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビアの地震で忘れられた生存者たち
articles.summary: コロンビアのペレイラでは、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋での生活を余儀なくされ、ホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして「数えられない」という問題に直面。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震が子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安を残す
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、幼い子供たちは恐怖、日常の崩壊、基本的な栄養保障の喪失に苦しんでいる。多くの家族が避難を強いられている。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民族殺害が増加
articles.summary: 政治的・経済的圧力により、ブラジルでは先住民族に対する暴力事件が増加。権利の枠組みの行き詰まりと土地画定への圧力が背景にある。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「大地の溜息」：ベネズエラの地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震後、あまり報じられないコミュニティの静かな余波を、ドキュメンタリー写真や個人の証言、デジタル介入を通じて記録・保存するプロジェクト。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震から1ヶ月以上が経過し、ラ・グアイラでは劣悪な状況と不十分な支援の中、数千人の親族が倒壊した建物のそばに留まり、行方不明の家族を捜索。

articles.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters are back - this time asking poll chief to resign
articles.description: Thousands of people have turned up at a protest in Mumbai called by the Cockroach Janta Party.

articles.summary: ムンバイで「ゴキブリ・ジャンタ党」が呼びかけた抗議デモに数千人が参加。選挙管理委員長の辞任を求めている。

articles.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes on Afghanistan
articles.description: The Afghan Taliban says nine civilians have died while Pakistan says the strikes killed 22 militants.
articles.titleJa: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに致命的な空爆を実施
articles.summary: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに空爆を行い、タリバンは民間人9人の死亡を主張。パキスタン側は武装勢力22人を殺害したと発表。

articles.title: Inside India's forest villages, where a dangerous mix of crises led to 32 child deaths
articles.description: At least 32 children have died in India's Balaghat district since May amid outbreaks of measles and malaria.
articles.titleJa: インドの森林村で複数の危機が重なり、子供32人が死亡
articles.summary: インドのバラガート地区で、はしかとマラリアの発生が重なり、5月以降少なくとも32人の子供が死亡した。

articles.title: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
articles.description: British universities are being urged to sever ties with China General Technology Research Institute which is linked to the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS).
articles.titleJa: 中国が英国の研究に資金提供し、北京のスパイに送っているとMI5が警告
articles.summary: MI5が、中国が英国の研究機関に資金提供し、その成果を中国のスパイ組織に送っていると警告。英国の大学に中国機関との関係断絶を促している。

articles.title: 'He will never walk free': Indian judge's letter promises child sex abuse survivor
articles.description: In the emotional letter, the judge describes the survivor as "the bravest little girl this court has ever seen".
articles.titleJa: 「彼は決して自由にはならない」：インド人判事が児童性的虐待の生存者に約束の手紙
articles.summary: インドの判事が児童性的虐待の生存者に感動的な手紙を送る。「彼は決して自由にはならない」と誓い、その勇敢さを称賛した。

articles.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
articles.description: The launch of FirstDate comes as the ageing nation wrestles with a record-low fertility rate.
articles.titleJa: シンガポール、公務員向けお見合いサービスを開始
articles.summary: シンガポールが公務員向けお見合いサービス「FirstDate」を開始。高齢化と過去最低の出生率に悩む国家の取り組みの一環。

articles.title: Watch: Couple describe relief at rescue after whale destroys their yacht
articles.description: Jeremy and Jemma Cooper were 500 miles off the coast of New Zealand when their yacht, the Tai Tam, collided with a sperm whale.
articles.titleJa: 映像：クジラがヨットを破壊、救助後の安堵を語るカップル
articles.summary: ニュージーランド沖500マイルでヨットがマッコウクジラと衝突し破壊された夫婦が、救助後の安堵感を語った。

articles.title: Restaurant named after Xi Jinping attacked by Chinese nationals in South Korea
articles.description: The owner said he chose the name because he wanted to run the "best Chinese restaurant" in South Korea.
articles.titleJa: 習近平にちなんだ名のレストラン、韓国で中国人によって襲撃される
articles.summary: 韓国で「習近平」と名付けられた中華レストランが中国人に襲撃される。店主は「韓国で最高の中華料理店」を目指したという。

articles.title: 'He's taught us courage': Friend on Indian pilot hailed as a hero
articles.description: Capt Smit Machchhar was attacked by another pilot onboard the Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv.

articles.summary: テルアビブ行きのフライトで別のパイロットに襲撃されたインド人パイロット、スミット・マチチャル機長が英雄として称賛されている。

articles.title: Watch: Luxury prison in Indonesia demolished after public outcry

articles.titleJa: 映像：インドネシアの豪華刑務所、国民の反発を受け解体
articles.summary: インドネシアの国会議員が水曜日、首都近くの刑務所内にある物議を醸していた豪華施設を解体するよう命じた。国民の反発を受けての決定。

articles.title: Director-General cites concerns with pace of negotiations as chairs report on state of play
articles.description: A meeting of the Trade Negotiations Committee (TNC) on 1 October provided WTO members with an opportunity to take stock of the WTO's negotiating agenda six months after the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in Yaoundé and voice their views on how to advance their work. Members heard readouts from the chairs of the negotiating bodies about the state of play in their respective talks.
articles.titleJa: 事務局長、交渉の進捗状況に関する議長の報告を受け、ペースへの懸念を表明
articles.summary: WTO貿易交渉委員会の会合で、事務局長は交渉のペースに懸念を示し、メンバーは進捗状況を確認し、今後の作業について意見交換した。

articles.title: Members take stock of latest discussions on WTO reform
articles.description: At a transparency session on 30 September, facilitators for the discussions on WTO reform reported on recent meetings among members on the four tracks of reform: foundational issues, decision- making, development and level playing field. The facilitators noted a high level of engagement with members' written and oral proposals submitted in recent weeks. They acknowledged that momentum is building across all four tracks, but substantial work remains.
articles.titleJa: メンバー、WTO改革に関する最新の議論を評価
articles.summary: WTO改革に関する透明性セッションで、メンバーは改革の4つの分野における議論の進捗状況を評価。高い関与が見られるものの、依然として多くの作業が必要と報告された。

articles.title: John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition kicks off with webinar support on offer
articles.description: Prospective participants in the 25th edition of the John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition on WTO Law, launched on 16 September 2026, are invited to attend webinars aimed at helping them to effectively participate in the competition.
articles.titleJa: ジョン・H・ジャクソン・模擬法廷大会がウェビナー支援で開幕
articles.summary: 第25回ジョン・H・ジャクソンWTO法模擬法廷大会が開催され、参加者向けに効果的な参加を支援するウェビナーが提供される。

articles.title: WTO members deepen discussions on trade and climate measures, share updates
articles.description: The Committee on Trade and Environment (CTE) met on 28-29 September to advance its discussions on the trade and environment nexus, focusing on interoperability and development aspects of trade-related climate measures. Members also built on the voluntary information sharing exercise launched earlier this year with a view to enhancing transparency of trade and climate measures in the Committee. In addition, they were briefed on work undertaken in other international fora and on developments in several member-led environmental initiatives at the WTO.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、貿易と気候変動対策に関する議論を深化、最新情報を共有
articles.summary: WTO貿易・環境委員会が開催され、貿易と気候変動対策の関連性について議論を深め、加盟国は気候変動関連の貿易措置に関する最新情報を共有し、透明性向上を目指した。

articles.title: New Zealand advances safe and inclusive trade with new contribution to STDF
articles.description: New Zealand has contributed NZ$ 300,000 (approximately CHF 140,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) to help developing and least-developed countries, including in the Pacific, strengthen food safety and animal and plant health systems.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド、STDFへの新たな貢献で安全かつ包摂的な貿易を推進
articles.summary: ニュージーランドはSTDFに30万NZドルの貢献を行い、太平洋地域の開発途上国などが食品安全や動植物の衛生システムを強化するのを支援する。

articles.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
articles.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.
articles.titleJa: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行がアジア太平洋地域で「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブを開催
articles.summary: WTO、ADB、世界銀行がマニラで地域会議を開催し、「開発のためのサービス貿易」イニシアチブをアジア太平洋地域に導入。地域関係者がサービス貿易の役割と政策アプローチについて議論した。

articles.title: Panel to review EU carbon border adjustment mechanism and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: The Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) agreed at its meeting on 25 September to a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances.
articles.titleJa: EU炭素国境調整メカニズムおよび排出量取引制度を審査するパネル設置へ
articles.summary: 紛争解決機関は、ロシア連邦の要請を受け、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズム（CBAM）と排出量取引制度における輸出補助金疑惑を審査するパネル設置に合意した。

articles.title: Members review farm policies in first meeting under new Chair
articles.description: At a meeting of the WTO Committee on Agriculture on 24-25 September, WTO members addressed matters raised regarding implementation of their commitments and members' specific notifications. They also discussed a counter-notification submitted by Australia on India's support policies for sugar and heard a briefing on the global state of farming from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). This was the first meeting under the new Chair, Mr William Horgan of Ireland.
articles.titleJa: 新議長の下で初の会合、農業政策を検討
articles.summary: WTO農業委員会が新議長の下で初の会合を開催。加盟国は農業に関するコミットメントの実施状況を検討し、オーストラリアが提出したインドの砂糖補助金政策に関する意見を議論した。

articles.title: WTO members review agriculture negotiation history, discuss ways forward
articles.description: WTO members expressed their views on 23 September regarding the current state of the agriculture negotiations and how best to move them forward following the inconclusive outcome of talks in this area at the WTO’s 14th Ministerial Conference in Yaoundé earlier this year.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、農業交渉の経緯をレビューし、今後の進め方を議論
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は、ヤウンデでの閣僚会議での結論が出なかった農業交渉の現状をレビューし、今後の交渉の進め方について意見を交換した。

articles.title: A critical juncture for the world trading system: what the evidence tells us
articles.description: The multilateral trading system has underpinned a nearly 50-fold expansion of world merchandise trade volume and one of the most remarkable periods of economic growth and development in modern history, yet global trade policy and the WTO are experiencing the most serious and sustained disruptions since the system was created 80 years ago.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易システムにとっての岐路：証拠が示すもの
articles.summary: 多角的貿易システムが過去80年間で世界貿易と経済成長を支えてきたが、現在、最も深刻かつ持続的な混乱に直面しており、重要な岐路にあることを指摘する。
